info.title: Salesforce REST API responses read by wp-woo-idempotent-importer
info.description: Salesforce publishes no OpenAPI document for its REST resources and sObjects. This subset is transcribed by hand from the REST API Developer Guide (https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/) and the Object Reference (https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/) for API version 62.0: only the responses the Salesforce adapter reads. Paths are relative to `<instance URL>/services/data/v62.0`.

QueryResult.description: The Query resource's response (https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/resources_query.htm): `done` is false while `nextRecordsUrl` names the next batch.

DescribeSObjectResult.description: The sObject Describe resource's response (https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.api_rest.meta/api_rest/resources_sobject_describe.htm), the parts the adapter reads.

Field.description: A field's describe (Field in the SOAP API's describeSObjects result, which the REST resource returns as JSON).

Account.description: A Account record (Object Reference: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.object_reference.meta/object_reference/sforce_api_objects_account.htm). Fields are those of the object's describe; a record also carries the org's custom fields (`<name>__c`), which no document can list.
